top_risks: Live acceptance remains UNPROVEN. No registry-absent job has been observed in a real delivered report. scripts/inspect_discovery_integration.py is the check to run after an approved deployment; a zero is legitimate and must be recorded as such.

Mocked storage does not establish runtime IAM. The design deliberately needs no new grant (one known key, no ListBucket or DeleteObject), and the template's declared grants were checked, but no deployed policy evaluation was performed.
A rollback performed while a batch is owed loses those observations, because P06 never drains the ledger. The receipt names the job ids; DEPLOYMENT_HANDOFF.md 6.3 says to check it first.
The owed-batch bound (5 per provider) and the live-view retention bound (21 days) are stated and reported when reached, but neither is calibrated against measured failure frequency or feed churn.

Packaging still ships the whole repository in every function, which is why all six artifacts change and why the report function can import src.discovery.live at all. A future packaging fix must carry that dependency explicitly.
The unattended round on 2026-09-26 is still pending and unverified; this run deployed nothing, so it remains a P06 observation when it happens.
